relationships.subject: VLT-projecting cACC (Cg2) neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that the activation of VLT-projecting cACC (Cg2) neurons induces anxiety-like behaviors in normal mice.

relationships.subject: berberine
relationships.evidence_quote: a significant decrease in neuronal activity was observed in VLT-projecting cACC (Cg2) neurons after 10 mg/kg BBR intervention

relationships.subject: berberine
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that 10 mg/kg BBR alleviated anxiety-like behaviors in mice after two weeks of CFA injection.

key_findings: Cg2 but not Cg1 cACC neurons project to VLT; activating them induces anxiety-like behavior, inhibiting them relieves it in CFA mice.
Berberine (10 mg/kg) reduces VLT-projecting cACC (Cg2) activity and its anxiolytic effect is reversed by activating these neurons.
